This role is a hybrid: part hands-on IT generalist (the occasional password/MFA reset, break/fix, or machine swap, plus the employee lifecycle), part IT Systems Administrator (owner of identity, device, and SaaS architecture), and part automation architect (the person who turns repeated work into workflows, APIs, and safe AI-assisted processes), all with a security-first mindset. Teams adopt tools quickly. We use Torii to discover and govern them, and we need someone to turn those findings into ownership, Okta-backed access, and renewal decisions. Access control still has manual seams. Some apps are provisioned from Rippling instead of Okta, some support SCIM but aren't configured, shared service accounts need governance, and RBAC for Sales/RevOps and other departments needs to be operationalized end to end. The lifecycle has timing and trigger gaps. Rippling → Okta activation timing, Ashby/Rippling → ticketing platform onboarding triggers, and offboarding audit trails all need durable, engineered workflows. Device trust is maturing. Okta Device Trust with Iru on macOS and Windows is live and expanding; we've seen why enrollment controls (not just access controls) matter. AI adoption is accelerating. Claude, Notion AI and agents, and n8n are in use. We need someone who can enable them quickly and safely, with scoped access, data-sensitivity controls, and governance. migrate remaining Rippling-provisioned apps and configure SCIM where supported but unused Design and maintain RBAC by department, role, and seniority; publish and maintain access control matrices Build birthright access, time-bound access (e.g., international travel), and automatic revocation Govern service and shared accounts: inventory, ownership, conversion to named accounts, credential rotation Run recurring access reviews and produce audit-ready evidence for SOC 2 and security reviews Partner with Security on zero-trust posture, device admission, geofencing, and Okta system log monitoring 2) Automation, workflows & integrations Design, build, and maintain automations in n8n , Okta Workflows , and our ticketing platform , connecting Okta, Rippling, Ashby, the ticketing platform, Slack, Google Workspace, Notion, and business apps Use REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth/API tokens, and JSON payloads confidently; read vendor API docs and build reliable integrations with error handling, retries, logging, and alerting Automate the employee lifecycle end to end: pre-hire prep, staged Okta creation and timed activation, Day-1 access, role/department changes, and offboarding with access revocation and audit trail Partner closely with HR / People Ops on lifecycle management: agree on HRIS data standards and trigger timing, coordinate start dates, role changes, leaves, and terminations (including sensitive or same-day exits), and handle HR data with discretion Turn access requests into self-service catalog items with approval routing by app sensitivity (Slack approve/deny, owner approvals, automatic provisioning on approval) Treat automations as production systems: version control or exportable definitions, documentation, runbooks, credential hygiene, least-privilege service accounts, and ownership 3) Device management (macOS & Windows) Our fleet is roughly 85% macOS and 15% Windows. Mac is the default, but Windows users get the same level of support, security, and polish. review_candidates.description: Hybrid role (3 days/week in office) at our Salt Lake City, Boise, Fargo, Portland, Vancouver, Renton, Medford, Burlington, Lewiston, Little Rock, and Springdale offices. Who We Are Looking For Every day, Cambia’s Systems Administrators are living our mission to make health care easier and lives better. As a member of the Server Engineering team, the Systems Administrator III position participates in a team environment for the installation, upgrades, testing and maintenance of new and existing computer systems, operating system, and/or software applications. This position provides technical, interpersonal and administrative skills in performing day-to-day work – all in service of making our members’ heath journeys easier. Do you thrive as a part of a collaborative, caring team? Then this role may be the perfect fit. Qualifications What You Bring to Cambia: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Business Administration, or a related field. Appropriate additional experience beyond the minimum required experience may be substituted for education. Skills And Attributes Five years experience in the implementation, operations, development and maintenance of IT systems and/or administration of Software functions in multi-platform and multi-system environments. Highly proficient understanding of design, implementation and sustainment activities of Information Technology systems. Must have experience with infrastructure management techniques such as change management, problem management, release management, configuration management and/or system lifecycle. Has a strong understanding in MS and/or UNIX environment including common suites and core business applications. Has a strong understanding of the appropriate environments for assigned applications. Ability to develop efficient and effective program and system solutions in solving light to medium complex business problems. Ability to automate tasks and document them for others to use; take direction from others. Ability to analyze, diagnose and resolve system performance problems or outages. Must be technically proficient in core technologies and methodologies used by the team. Ability to effectively adapt to rapidly changing technologies and methodologies and apply them to technological and/or business needs. Demonstrated ability to upgrade hardware operating system software and third party software. Demonstrated ability to plan and document medium to large product upgrades. Demonstrated ability to lead Disaster Recovery team, including scripting and testing for operating systems, third party software and storage recovery. Experience in project management techniques and the ability to lead projects to a timely successful outcome Must have strong ability to project/forecast time allocation for project completion. Must be able to effectively communicate with coworkers and all levels of management both verbally and written. Preferred Skills Automation technologies, Ansible, Packer, Terraform. Microsoft Azure platform and VM management What You Will Do At Cambia As part of the Server Engineering team, support and manage AIX, RHEL, Windows and VMware infrastructure Installs and configures computing systems and/or support software in support of business processes and objectives. May be accountable for researching and solving highly complex software issues and collaborates with vendors and other support teams in regards to product or Infrastructure problems. Perform hardware installation and configuration; operating system and support software installation, upgrade, and patches; performance tuning; and documentation. Research, analyze and submit analysis and recommendations for software development, enhancement, replacement or purchase. This individual may lead project teams based on experience and knowledge. Collaborate closely with infrastructure, security, and application architects to design and implement automated solutions that ensure high-quality, reliable, and secure business operations. Administers the integration of licensed and/or in-house developed applications and writing programs and/or scripting to integrate with other systems. Participates in the research and estimating of proposed work. Responsible for initiating process and system improvements and monitoring industry trends Provides support and coordination in the effective administration of computing systems and support software. Directs and takes actions to ensure maximum systems availability Provides technical training to team or Business partners through training sessions. Acts as a consultant to manage, configure, implement, monitor, identify, diagnose, resolve problems and perform analysis in relation to the integrated IT environment and software. Demonstrates knowledge in networked computing structure and architecture. Prepares and/or directs program, system, operational and User documentation. Prepares individual work plans and reports activities, tasks, milestones, deliverables, schedules, and status reports, as appropriate. Works as an active team member for joint success of a project, taking responsibility, and providing timely updates for, assigned action items and deliverables. May be required to maintain professional working relationships with vendors. Focuses on the operational activities that ensure maximum availability and reliability of the supported platform/technology. Uses common system maintenance tools, without assistance. Provides leadership and mentoring to other team members. Uses crossover knowledge into other technical disciplines, which facilitate the understanding, coordination and communication between technical areas. Adapts to new technology and methodologies. The full salary range is $88,000 - $143,000 and the bonus target is 10%. The expected salary range is $93,500 - $126,500/year. Regional pay structure — applies to North Dakota and Idaho and Utah locations outside the metro areas listed above: The full salary range is $79,500 - $113,900 and the bonus target is 10%. The expected salary range is $84,200 - $113,900.
